meta.title: InsightUp
meta.description: Track InBody records, review chart trends, and manage a reliable body composition history.

intro.title: InsightUp Product Intro
intro.description: Turn InBody records into readable trend views so you can quickly understand changes, preserve context, and build a more consistent tracking habit.

sections.insightBody: Dashboard gives each card a single job so signals do not get mixed together.
sections.controlBody: Records handles create, edit, and chart-inclusion rules in one place so tracking stays clean.
sections.evidenceBody: Excluding a record from charts is not the same as deleting it. The full history stays available for comparison.
sections.workflowTitle: From record to decision, the flow stays simple.
sections.workflowBody: Use Records to organize InBody data, then open Dashboard to review trends. The split keeps the mental model simple and matches daily usage.
sections.audienceTitle: Built for people who want to track consistently without getting buried in data.
sections.audienceBody1: You measure InBody regularly and want to know quickly whether the latest change is worth reading into.
sections.audienceBody2: You mainly review records on mobile and want the first screen after login to be useful.
sections.audienceBody3: You want to keep the full history while controlling which records enter chart analysis.
sections.principle1Body: Dashboard is optimized for interpretation, not for mixing in maintenance tasks.
sections.principle2Title: Exclude from analysis does not mean delete
sections.principle2Body: The product keeps the full record history so you can adjust chart signals without losing context.
sections.principle3Body: Important information is compressed into easy-to-read surfaces, while deeper context lives in secondary pages.
sections.rule1Body: Raw measurements stay in the database and do not disappear when excluded from charts.
sections.rule2Body: You decide which records appear in charts and which stay as background reference.
sections.rule3Body: Photo scan remains review-first so incorrect data does not contaminate the main chart surface.
